## Personality

Conseil is a phlegmatic, imperturbable, and consistently polite individual who maintains a calm and self-possessed demeanor regardless of the circumstances. He is characterized by a ceremonious nature, often speaking in the third person, and is noted for his prudence. Highly skilled and quick with his hands, he possesses a deep knowledge of conchology and is adept at classifying fish.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER III I FORM MY RESOLUTION P4](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0004), [v1 CHAPTER III I FORM MY RESOLUTION P6](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0006), [v1 CHAPTER V AT A VENTURE P8](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0008), [v1 CHAPTER VII AN UNKNOWN SPECIES OF WHALE P22](../source/v01-c07.md#nw-v01-c07-p0022), [v1 CHAPTER VII AN UNKNOWN SPECIES OF WHALE P25](../source/v01-c07.md#nw-v01-c07-p0025), [v1 CHAPTER VIII MOBILIS IN MOBILI P5](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0005), +6 more_

## History

Conseil, a devoted Flemish servant, spent ten years accompanying Professor [Aronnax](../character/professor-aronnax.md) on scientific expeditions before joining him on the frigate [Abraham Lincoln](../codex/tech.md#abraham-lincoln) to hunt a mysterious sea monster. After the ship failed to capture the creature and the men were thrown overboard, Conseil rescued the professor, and both were eventually taken captive aboard the submarine [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus). Under the command of Captain [Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md), Conseil and his companions were forced into a life of confinement and exploration beneath the waves, utilizing advanced diving technology to traverse the ocean floor. Throughout their journey across the [Pacific](../codex/places.md#north-pacific) and Indian Oceans, Conseil observed the vessel's scientific operations and participated in hunting excursions on islands such as [Papua](../codex/places.md#papua). His loyalty to [Aronnax](../character/professor-aronnax.md) remained constant even as the group faced dangers from hostile islanders and the mysterious, often secretive nature of Captain [Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md). Ultimately, Conseil continued to serve his master while witnessing the somber realities of life aboard the submarine, including the burial of a crewman in an underwater cemetery.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER III I FORM MY RESOLUTION P3](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0003), [v1 CHAPTER III I FORM MY RESOLUTION P4](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0004), [v1 CHAPTER III I FORM MY RESOLUTION P5](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0005), [v1 CHAPTER III I FORM MY RESOLUTION P7](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0007), [v1 CHAPTER III I FORM MY RESOLUTION P9](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0009), [v1 CHAPTER III I FORM MY RESOLUTION P11](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0011), +435 more_

## Quotes

> “In this, friend Ned is right,” said Conseil, “and I agree with him. Could not master obtain permission from his friend Captain Nemo to put us on land, if only so as not to lose the habit of treading on the solid parts of our planet?”
>
> — Conseil — [v1 CHAPTER XIX TORRES STRAITS P37](../source/v01-c19.md#nw-v01-c19-p0037)

> “May I be permitted to say, sir,” replied Conseil, “that I never reckoned on getting the prize; and, had the government of the Union offered a hundred thousand dollars, it would have been none the poorer.”
>
> — Conseil — [v1 CHAPTER V AT A VENTURE P23](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0023)

> “Master is right,” replied Conseil; “and I propose to reserve three places in our vessel, one for fruits, the other for vegetables, and the third for the venison, of which I have not yet seen the smallest specimen.”
>
> — Conseil — [v1 CHAPTER XX A FEW DAYS ON LAND P10](../source/v01-c20.md#nw-v01-c20-p0010)

> "Ned! Ned! what are you saying? You, a man-eater? I should not feel safe with you, especially as I share your cabin. I might perhaps wake one day to find myself half devoured."
>
> — Conseil — [v1 CHAPTER XX A FEW DAYS ON LAND P16](../source/v01-c20.md#nw-v01-c20-p0016)

> “I would not trust you,” replied Conseil. “But enough. We must absolutely bring down some game to satisfy this cannibal, or else one of these fine mornings, master will find only pieces of his servant to serve him.”
>
> — Conseil — [v1 CHAPTER XX A FEW DAYS ON LAND P18](../source/v01-c20.md#nw-v01-c20-p0018)

## Relationships

### [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/conseil--ned-land.md)

Conseil and [Ned Land](../character/ned-land.md) are fellow passengers and companions who were both thrown overboard from the [Abraham Lincoln](../codex/tech.md#abraham-lincoln) and subsequently captured by the crew of the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus). Their relationship is defined by their shared status as prisoners, though they exhibit different temperaments while confined in their cabin. While Conseil remains composed, Ned Land's growing agitation and frustration with their captivity occasionally lead to volatile outbursts, such as his physical attack on the ship's steward.

- Comrade of — fellow passenger on the Nautilus  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER VII AN UNKNOWN SPECIES OF WHALE P59](../source/v01-c07.md#nw-v01-c07-p0059), [v1 CHAPTER VIII MOBILIS IN MOBILI P1](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER IX NED LAND’S TEMPERS P22](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0022), +12 more</sub>
- Friend of — close companions  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER VIII MOBILIS IN MOBILI P5](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0005), [v1 CHAPTER IX NED LAND’S TEMPERS P19](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0019), [v1 CHAPTER XIV A NOTE OF INVITATION P0](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0000), +2 more</sub>

### [Professor Aronnax](../character/professor-aronnax.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/conseil--professor-aronnax.md)

Conseil serves as a dedicated servant and loyal companion to Professor [Aronnax](../character/professor-aronnax.md), accompanying him throughout the expedition on the [Abraham Lincoln](../codex/tech.md#abraham-lincoln) and their subsequent abduction. He remains by the Professor's side during their imprisonment on the [Nautilus](../codex/tech.md#nautilus), providing support as they navigate their new circumstances under Captain [Nemo](../character/captain-nemo.md). Their bond is characterized by Conseil's unwavering commitment to his master's safety and his participation in the various activities, such as the hunting expedition at [Crespo](../codex/places.md#crespo), that the Professor undertakes while aboard the submarine.

- Serves under — servant  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER VIII MOBILIS IN MOBILI P23](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0023)</sub>
- Comrade of — servant and companion on the Nautilus  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XIV A NOTE OF INVITATION P16](../source/v01-c14.md#nw-v01-c14-p0016)</sub>
